description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the restaurant detail screen, including UI layout, state management, and interactions for displaying restaurant details and menu items.

classes.name: RestaurantDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget displaying details for a specific restaurant, including menu items and navigation to the cart.

classes.name: _RestaurantDetailScreenState
classes.description: State class managing data fetching and UI rendering for RestaurantDetailScreen.

classes.name: _MenuTile
classes.description: Stateless widget representing an individual menu item with add-to-cart functionality.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, triggering the fetch of menu items after widget is built.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the restaurant detail screen, including app bar, list of menu items, and loading indicator.
